selected_architecture.summary: Re-run the previously reviewed radius-1 neighborhood versus global surviving-intent allocation comparison over all 36 matched origin-drop stresses, but bind selection to the exact reviewed nine-paper baseline artifact produced by DEPTH_FALLBACK_COMPLETES_ALL_NINE rather than reconstructing an incomplete top3-only baseline.

scientific_question: With a complete teacher-blind matched 28/4 baseline now frozen for all nine papers, do radius-1 local source-neighborhood rescue and global surviving-intent allocation recover complementary, local-only, allocation-only, equivalent, or no structural origin-drop cases under the unchanged one-slot recovery rules?

established: The original cross-paper comparison run 40146681400 was scientifically gated as INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE_GENERALIZATION because arxiv:2501.15391 instantiated only 27 selected propositions and three tier1 reservation events.

The baseline-only run 40148614485 returned DEPTH_FALLBACK_COMPLETES_ALL_NINE: all nine papers now have 28 selected propositions and four reservation events; eight prior complete baselines are unchanged and arxiv:2501.15391 preserves its original three-event prefix plus one rank5 source-method event.
Independent review accepted the all-nine baseline result and authorized a newly frozen corrected comparison, not a direct rerun of the incomplete experiment.
The two recovery arms from the original design remain independently reviewed and unchanged: RADIUS1_SURVIVING_PATH_RESCUE_V1 and GLOBAL_SURVIVING_INTENT_ALLOCATION_V1.
The prior incomplete 8-paper counts (local exact=3, allocation exact=1) are diagnostic-only negative/partial evidence and may not tune this design.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Local adjacency and surviving-intent allocation reconstruct different origin-dropped reservations across the complete 36-case stress set.
Radius-1 local source structure recovers dropped reservations that global surviving-intent allocation does not, with no reciprocal allocation-only recoveries.
Global surviving-intent allocation recovers dropped reservations unavailable to radius-1 local rescue, with no reciprocal local-only recoveries.
The two bounded static recovery families either recover exactly the same cases or recover none.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Either both_exact_recovery_count > 0 with both exclusive counts zero, or both arm exact-recovery totals are zero.

incomplete_comparison.role: Historical diagnostic only. Its mechanism counts cannot tune or determine the corrected verdict.

all_nine_baseline.role: Authoritative teacher-blind baseline identity for this corrected comparison.

mechanism_family_comparison.rationale: Retained exactly from the independently reviewed prior cross-paper design; tests bounded local source-neighborhood structure with surviving-path corroboration.
Retained exactly from the independently reviewed prior cross-paper design; tests global teacher-blind evidence allocation over all surviving tier1 top12 paths.
A hybrid is justified only if the complete 36-case comparison shows mutually exclusive recoveries.
Adds a new sufficiency/gap control mechanism and is not justified while the two static families have not been validly compared on all nine papers.
Current residual is structural recovery under a complete baseline; prior evidence does not reopen generation deficiency or rejected pairwise semantic certificate families.

selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Compare the unchanged local-neighborhood and global surviving-intent allocation arms across all 36 leave-one-reservation-origin-out stresses derived from the exact reviewed all-nine baseline artifact.

frozen_inputs.teacher_use: No teacher labels, anti-leak filters, historical evidence pages, removed proposition identities, or previous recovery outcomes may generate/rank/select baseline or recovery candidates. Historical evidence pages remain posthoc secondary context only.

steps: Recover the exact baseline-depth fallback report from artifact 12582395555 and verify exact ZIP/report SHA256.
For each corpus paper, require final_complete=true, final_selected_count=28, final_event_count=4, and exact proposition/page locatability against the authoritative PDF.
Materialize the 28 selected proposition rows by exact final_selected_proposition_ids from the reviewed report; do not recompute baseline selection for the comparison.
Use exact final_reservation_events from the reviewed report as the four matched stress origins in their recorded frontier order.
Recompute only frozen tier1 BM25 top12 rankings from the exact generated-intent artifact for recovery-path support; these rankings may not alter baseline identity.

operation: Require the teacher-blind baseline to contain exactly 24 core propositions plus four tier1 reservation events.
Create four stress cases per valid paper, one for each reservation event in frontier order.
For one stress case, remove exactly that reservation proposition from the 28-set, yielding 27 propositions.
Exclude that reservation event's selecting intent (generator_id + intent_index) from all recovery-path support for that stress.
Do not remove or alter any other selected proposition, query, rank, or intent.
The removed proposition identity is hidden from both recovery arms and is used only for posthoc structural exact-recovery scoring.
stress_generator.baseline_completeness_gate: The exact reviewed baseline artifact must materialize 28 selected propositions and four reservation events for each of all nine papers. Any mismatch is INVALID_EXECUTION, not a scientific recovery verdict.

candidate_generation: Use the three surviving non-core reservation propositions as seeds in original frontier order.
Generate immediate predecessor and successor propositions on the same authoritative PDF page only.
Exclude already-selected propositions and cross-page neighbors.
A neighbor is eligible only if it appears within top12 of at least one surviving tier1 intent.
arm_a_local_neighborhood.action: Append exactly the top-ranked eligible candidate; if none, arm returns NO_CANDIDATE.

candidate_generation: Use all unique unselected propositions appearing within BM25 top12 of surviving tier1 intents.
Do not use adjacency, teacher labels, semantic similarity, or new queries.
Annotate every candidate with best surviving BM25 rank and rank_stratum=SHALLOW_FRONTIER for ranks1-3 or DEPTH_EXTENSION for ranks4-12.
candidate_ranking: earliest surviving intent accepted-order index ascending
arm_b_surviving_intent_allocation.action: Append exactly the top-ranked eligible candidate; if none, arm returns NO_CANDIDATE.

provenance: all baseline/rescue propositions exactly locatable to authoritative PDF page/proposition identity
no teacher data used in baseline/stress/candidate generation/ranking

INVALID_EXECUTION: Any all-nine baseline artifact identity, generated-intent identity, corpus/PDF provenance, 28/4 materialization, stress count, teacher boundary, or exact recovery-arm contract fails.
Interpretation: no scientific verdict; repair only unchanged replay/identity mechanics with fresh explicit recovery authority.
COMPLEMENTARY_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Interpretation: local context and surviving-intent allocation recover different origin-dropped selections across the valid 36-case corpus; next design should test a deterministic hybrid rather than arbitrarily choose one family.
LOCAL_STRUCTURAL_ADVANTAGE: Interpretation: radius-1 rescue adds structural recovery unavailable to global surviving-intent allocation under the corrected all-nine baseline. Cost metrics govern the bounded follow-up.
SURVIVING_ALLOCATION_ADVANTAGE: Interpretation: global surviving-intent allocation adds structural recovery unavailable to radius-1 rescue. Allocation rank-stratum counts distinguish shallow schedule allocation from true depth extension.
BOTH_STRUCTURALLY_WEAK: Interpretation: neither static family reconstructs any origin-dropped selection; move toward adaptive gap/sufficiency planning rather than posthoc radius/depth tuning.
EQUIVALENT_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Interpretation: both mechanisms recover exactly the same stress cases; use frozen cost/simplicity metrics for the next discriminator, not semantic-equivalence claims.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid scientific execution after independent design review. Stop at the first frozen verdict. No changes to exact baseline artifact, 36 stress origins, radius1 local arm, global surviving-intent top12 arm, rank-stratum definition, ranking rules, budget28, metrics, or interpretation after seeing the result.

pass_authority.COMPLEMENTARY_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Authorize a later deterministic hybrid recovery design using the same fixed all-nine baseline; no production promotion.
pass_authority.LOCAL_STRUCTURAL_ADVANTAGE: Authorize a later broader neighborhood-aware robustness/cost design and collection of proposition-level heldout semantic labels before semantic generalization.
pass_authority.SURVIVING_ALLOCATION_ADVANTAGE: If advantage is predominantly SHALLOW_FRONTIER, authorize schedule-allocation redesign; if predominantly DEPTH_EXTENSION, authorize deeper-per-intent robustness/cost design; if mixed, keep both hypotheses live. Collect proposition-level heldout labels before semantic generalization.
pass_authority.BOTH_STRUCTURALLY_WEAK: Authorize evidence-first adaptive gap/sufficiency-controller research; do not tune radius/depth post hoc.
pass_authority.EQUIVALENT_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Authorize only the lower-cost/simpler mechanism as the next bounded structural design; if cost is tied, require a new discriminator rather than arbitrary selection.

reviewer_boundary: Independent reviewer must audit this exact corrected design before implementation. Routine implementation/CI/trigger mechanics do not require reviewer stops unless the frozen science changes. A genuine result requires post-result review before further phase selection.
next_safe_action: Run normal CI on this design-only artifact and merge only if clean. Then checkpoint exact design in workspace-control and obtain independent review before implementing ALL_NINE_FIXED_BASELINE_RECOVERY_COMPARISON_V1.
